technique_name: Compose a story about a knight.
description: Once upon a time, there lived a brave and noble knight named Sir Arthur. He was renowned for his courage and honor, and he was respected and admired by all who met him. Sir Arthur had many adventures, fighting evil and protecting the innocent. One day, a powerful wizard appeared and offered him a special quest: a quest to save the kingdom from an evil dragon. Sir Arthur accepted the quest and soon found himself face-to-face with the dragon. After a long and dangerous fight, he emerged victorious
